body_html:
Since 2012, DJ Fresh has been turning moments into memories.

Born and raised in Brooklyn, NY, Jakeem—known professionally as DJ Fresh—brings over a decade of experience, unmatched musical versatility, and an infectious energy that elevates every event he touches. Whether he’s entertaining a corporate crowd, celebrating with a mitzvah family, or packing the dance floor at a wedding, his focus is always the same: deliver an unforgettable experience.

What drives DJ Fresh?

From the moment he first stepped behind the decks, DJ Fresh was hooked by the art of mixing and the joy that radiates from a crowd when the perfect song hits. “I love the reaction of enjoyment from the audience—it’s exhilarating.”

Signature Style

In his headphones, you’ll often find 90’s and 2000’s Hip-Hop & R&B, but his true superpower is blending all genres—Top 40, EDM, classics, Latin, Caribbean, pop, mitzvah favorites, and more—seamlessly and with purpose.

Dance Floor Expertise

DJ Fresh feeds off the energy of the room, tailoring every set to its unique demographic. Some of his tried-and-true floor fillers include:

  • “Snap Yo Fingers” – Lil Jon
  • “Be Faithful (Put Your Hands Up)” – Fatman Scoop
  • “Give Me Everything” – Pitbull

But above all, he reads the crowd in real time to deliver exactly what they need.

Why Clients Love Him

For corporate clients, he’s polished, reliable, and knows how to set the right mood for everything from galas to brand activations.
For mitzvah families, he brings hype, interaction, and fun—while keeping it clean and family-friendly.
For weddings, he creates a seamless soundtrack that reflects each couple’s style and keeps the dance floor full all night.

Outside the DJ Booth

When he’s not mixing music, DJ Fresh loves staying active and working out—fueling the high-energy presence he’s known for behind the turntables.

The DJ Fresh Promise

“Hello, I’m DJ Fresh. I specialize in blending all genres to create an electric atmosphere that keeps dance floors packed and guests fully engaged. My goal is simple: deliver unforgettable energy tailored to your event. I’d love to bring that same proven vibe to your celebration or venue.”
